journey.name: TL-16 A failure arriving over a pending undo waits its turn
journey.description:
REGRESSION GUARD. This journey used to assert the defect: `post(TaskDeleted)` and `reportFailure(Failure)` wrote into the same single nullable field, so any unrelated failure - a toggle, a refresh - that arrived while an undo offer was up silently consumed it, and the deleted task went with it. Filed as issue #15 and now fixed: messages queue, and a failure cannot displace an offer that has not been acted on.
It mattered more than TL-09 because the user did nothing to cause it. One lost dice roll in a background write was enough to take away the only route back from a delete they were still deciding about.
The failure is not swallowed either - it is still shown, after the offer it used to replace. That ordering is the whole guarantee, so both halves are asserted here.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Renew domain registration" row
Verify that a message reading "Task deleted" is on screen
Using adb, break the source with `am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 1.0`
Tap the checkbox with the content description "Mark complete" on the "Reply to design feedback" row
Verify that the message reading "Task deleted" with its "Undo" action is still on screen
Verify that the "Reply to design feedback" row still has an unchecked checkbox
Using adb, heal the source with `am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 0.0`
Tap the "Undo" action on that message
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is on screen again
Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is now on screen, behind the offer it used to replace
